items.title: MERSCO Joins Walmart’s Hardlines Category Exchange, Exploring Opportunities in Backyard Play Expansion and Peak-Season Strategy
items.summary: SHENZHEN, China, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- On October 21, 2026, Walmart hosted an in-person Global E-commerce Hardlines Category Exchange. MERSCO, a backyard play brand and Walmart marketplace seller, was invited to participate in the event, where it met face-to-face with Walmart’s North American merchant team and global business representatives.
